description: This file defines and extends a Heading node for a rich text editor, including attributes, commands, input rules, node view, and a plugin for handling heading-related behaviors such as collapsing sections and updating node states.

classes.name: Heading
classes.description: A custom heading node extending Tiptap's Heading with additional attributes and behaviors, including collapsibility, keyboard shortcuts, and node view customization.

methods.name: toggleNodesUnderPos
methods.description: Recursively toggles the 'hidden' attribute of nodes under a heading position to implement collapse/expand functionality.
